description: Two actors share a compact persistent world. A guardian (20 HP) guards the relic vault; defeating it unlocks the east passage. Talk to the guardian for lore. A hostile patrol (15 HP) in the vault-entrance attacks on sight. Use the ward-sigil (from camp) to calm the patrol, then talk to it for clues. NPCs respawn: patrol after 3 ticks, guardian after 5 ticks. A helm and a ward-sigil in camp can be taken or used. All object, room, NPC, and dialogue state persists across save/load/reconnect. A revive-kit in camp can be used to restore a defeated teammate (25 HP).
